tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga'i bsnyen sgrub rjes gnang bcas gsal bar bkod pa rdo rje pha lam phreng mdzes bzhugs so//

༄༅"$ // na mo gu ru badz+ra dha ra dharma sa ga rā ya/ bde bar gshegs rnams bgro ba mdzad nas gsang gsum bdag por khyod bkod zil// srid pa'i dbang chen yongs kyis bzod dka' bka' nan phab pas bran du zhugs// 'phrog byed nga rgyal chen po slar khros zhabs kyis brdzis nas srog bral bas// nus pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i chen po phyag na rdo rje 'chang la bstod// rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud las bstan pa'i zil// 'phags bod grub pa'i zhal sgor chags pa'i bcud// dpal ldan 'brug pa'i thugs mdzod du lhag pa// gtum po khyung lnga'i don gnyis sgrub rim 'bri// de'ang dpal mnyam med 'brug pa rin po che'i thugs dam sgrub thabs lnga'i ya gyal gtum po nus mthu'i skor/ 'di la sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba rgyas pa'i lugs dang*/ ma 'brel ba bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub tshul sogs rgya cher bzhugs pa las/ bsdus pa dpa' gcig gtum po khyung lnga'i sgo nas rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi rim pa 'chad par bya ba la/ sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor dang cho ga la 'jug pa'i bya ba/ dngos gzhi rang gzhan gyi don ji ltar sgrub pa/ rjes de dag gi mjug bsdu ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor dang cho ga la 'jug pa'i bya ba ni/ de'ang bsnyen sgrub la 'jug par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag ni/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ snying rje ldan zhing shes rab che// bzod ldan brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs// bslab pa gsum ldan dad pas brgyan// dpa' zhing gsang ba'i spyod pa shes// gus shing g.yo med skyabs gnas gsum// rtag tu mchod cing yengs pa med// lhag pa'i lha la yid ches shing*// phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang thob pas// dam tshig brda don nges par 'dzin// zhes gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang dang byin rlabs thob pa'i gang zag des gnas ji lta bur bsgrub na/

gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ dur khrod brgyad dang nye ba'i gnas// dur khrod nags kyi nang dang ni// ri rtse brag ri sngon po'i mdog /khros pa'i gzugs 'dra byang lta ba// me tog sngon pos mdzes pa dang*// ne'u gsing chu dang ut+pal nags// dben zhing yid 'ong nyams dga' ba// bkra shis dpal 'phel dbang yang 'dzin// lcang lo can dang ming mthun pa// sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i gnas su shis// zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'am/ bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs shing sgrub pa'i gnas dben zhing yid du 'ong bar dus bzang po la byi dor dang gtsang sbra legs par byas/ gong du gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten ji ltar 'byor pa bshams pa'i mdun/ bsnyen pa kho na'i skabs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo bcas dang*/ ka pā la'am rin po che'i snod du bya'i sha khrag sogs ma 'dres pa'i gtor spod kyis sbag pa'i 'bru gtsang gi phye las mchod gtor pad 'dab bzhis mtshan pa/ dkar rtsi mar rgyan ze'u 'bru sngon por ldan pa la bza' ba dang bca' bar 'os pa'i zas snas brum thabs su bskor ba dang*/ myos byed kyi btung ba'i snod tsam bshams/ mdun dkyil sgrub mchod gzhan rjes 'dzin dang 'brel na/ mdun du stegs bu khod snyoms gru bzhi'i dbus/ thig chen brgyad gdab ste rdul tshon gyi sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag phyi rol du mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar nyi gdan la rdo rje mthing nag rtse lnga'i lte bar sa bon hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bri ba'am/ mi 'grub na ras bris sam/ maṇ+ḍal la me tog mthing ga'i tshom bu bkod pa'i steng*/ mañji'i khar gong bshad lta bu'i gtor ma brjid ldan rtser sku tsak dang dar gdugs mthing kas mtshan pa bzhag pa'i/ g.yas phyogs su rin po che'i bum pa tshad ldan/ mgul chings sngon po dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan bcas pa nyer lnga'i rdzas ldan bcud kyis gtams pa dang*/

rgyab tu me tog sngon por bcas pa'i ru rak+sha'i sngags phreng*/ g.yon du gnam lcags rdo rje dar mthing cod pan can nam tsakli gang bder khyung rigs lnga'i tsakli/ byang shar mtshams su las bum mgul chings ljang khu ldan pa/ mdun du gong bshad mchod gtor zas snas bskor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas phyogs nas 'go brtsams pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar/ 'byor na dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan rdzas sna tshogs pas bkod legs su brgyan/ gzhan yang*/ sngon gtor maṇ+ḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad/ sgrub po'i mdun du nang mchod dang*/ ḍa ma ru rdo dril bcas 'tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa/ dngos gzhi rang gzhan gyi don ji ltar sgrub pa la bdag don bsnyen pa/ gnyis don mdun bum sgrub mchod/ gzhan don rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po stan bde bar kha byang du phyogs pa'am der mos pas 'khod/ nges 'byung dang gzhan phan gyi bsam pas kun nas slongs shing*/ skyabs yul rgya mtshor dmigs te dad gdung rtse gcig pas/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ sogs kyi skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po sogs sems bskyed kyang lan gsum bya/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dkar po sogs/ byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bsgom la yig brgya nyer gcig bzlas/ mgon po bdag ni sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim par bsam pas rgyud yongs su dag par bya/ de nas mchod rdzas/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang gi nang du oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed pa nam mkha'i khams khyab par

bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pad+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar de bzhin du sbyar bas brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi sogs/ a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod la ro mo bsgrag cing byin dbab bo// de nas/ rang nyid skad cig gi dpal rdo rje gtum por gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang bcud kyi sems can lhar gyur/ tshur 'dus pas bla ma gsang ba'i bdag po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa la/ gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi pho brang na// bcom ldan rdo rje gtum po ni// yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs// skyon med sku la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid stong pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// smon lam dbang gis khyung chen skur sprul nas// thabs la mkhas pas sna tshogs skur ston pa'i// rgyal sras khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag 'tshal/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa thams cad la// bdag gis ci nus dmigs pa'i mchod 'bul na// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po ltar// sku gsung thugs la mnyes pas mchod gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dhūṣ+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas// sdig pa ma lus bgyis pa rnams// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yi// spyan sngar da lta so sor bshags// shes rab snying rje ldan pa'i byang chub sems// dus gsum rgyal bas ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin/ de yi rjes su bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// byang chub sems ni nam yang mi gtong ngo*// bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang ni// gsang sngags kun bdag rdo rje 'dzin// de rig 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor rnams// dge ba mdzad la rjes yi rang*// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// 'khor dang bcas la lus 'bul na// bzhes nas bdag la rjes mthun pa'i// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal du gsol// dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas// da lta'i dge ba gang bsags pa// bdag dang sems can don slad du// byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi//

zhes yan lag lhag ma rnams byas la tshogs bsags pa'i mthar/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi spyi bor thim par bsam la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// zhes tshad med bzhi bsgom mo// de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor dngos ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ phyi gzung ba'i yul thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i gnas su rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba zhig tu gyur/ de las yi ge hūm̐ zhig chad pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang drwa ba/ phyi rol thams cad rdo rje'i me ri kha dog lnga'i bdag nyid can/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i me dpung lta bus yongs su gang ba/ de'i phyi rol du rlung spu gri can/ de'i phyi rol du ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtsho/ de'i phyi rol du mun pa mi bzad pa/ de'i phyi rol du nags stug po/ de'i phyi rol du sbrul gdug pa can/ de'i phyi rol du gcan gzan gtum po'i 'obs kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ srung 'khor gyi nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ kā li dmar po 'od 'bar zhing reg bya tsha ba nyis 'gyur gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

ā li dkar po reg bya bsil ba nyis 'gyur gyis mtshan pa/ de gnyis kha sbyar gyi bar du rang gi sems nyid ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po dang a dmar po gnyis su gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ dang a la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu ba las pad+ma dmar po as mtshan pa dang*/ rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de gnyis 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid dpal rdo rje gtum po sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyangs bas dbang phyug chen po kha dog sngon po mnan pa/ g.yas bskum pas u ma de wi kha dog dmar po mnan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum me stag gi phung po ltar dmar ba/ dbu skra ag tshoms smin ma kham ser gyen du 'bar ba/ sbrul dkar pos thod du bcings pa/ ser pos rna cha dang mgul brgyan pa/ ljang khus lag gdub/ dmar pos mgul rgyan dang ska rags/ nag pos do shal dang rkang gdub byas pa/ chos gos sngon pos stod dkris shing rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bde ma sku mdog dmar ljang gcer bu skra grol zhing thur du 'phyang ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i gri gug sdigs par mdzad pa/ g.yon pa bdud la sogs pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas dbang phyug gi steng du brkyangs shing*/ g.yon yab dang gnyis med du 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/

yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros sa steng sa bla sa 'og gi sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje gtum po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i rigs thams cad bsdus nas gnas gsum gyi phyag mtshan yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pa las/ spyi bor sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ snying khar thugs rdo rje sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o// mig tu bh+rūṃ las spyan ras gzigs/ rna bar hūm̐ las nam mkha'i snying po/ snar khaṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel/ lcer aṃ las 'jam dbyangs/ dpral bar hūm̐ las 'od dpag med/ snying khar haṃ las kun tu bzang po/ yab kyi thugs kar badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūm̐ rdo rje'i khyung sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sbrul sngo khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ bud+dha ga ru ḍa oṃ/ spyi bor 'khor lo'i khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon sbrul dkar khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa āḥ mgrin par pad+ma'i khyung dmar po g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon sbrul dmar khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad pad+ma'i rang bzhin can/ rat+na ga ru ḍa trām̐/ lte bar rin po che'i khyung ser po g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon sbrul ser khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad rin po che'i rang bzhin can/ karma ga ru ḍa ā/ gsang gnas su ral gri'i khyung ljang khu g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon sbrul ljang khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad ral gri'i rang bzhin can/ rang gi snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje mthing nag 'bar ba'i lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa de las 'od 'phros/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang gi lha tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs pa la/ gang gis 'khor ba'i sogs/ bsngo bar bgyi/ bar gong ltar yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi// thugs kyi sras po ded dpon che// 'jig rten thams cad 'dul mdzad pa// dpa' bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum po dpa' bo 'jigs par byed// klu 'dul gzhan gyis mi thub pa// drag po 'jigs par byed pa'i lha// rdo rje gtum por phyag 'tshal bstod// gzung ma yid 'ong rgyal ba 'dis// rnam dag mchod cing sdug bsngal 'joms// ma lus 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal// rdo rje bde mar phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen mo// rdo rje bde ma bde ster ma// rtog pa thams cad gcod mdzad pa'i// yum mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// khams gsum sems can thams cad la// mi ma yin gyis 'tshe byed pa// 'joms phyir khyung chen skur sprul nas// 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam rtog 'joms mdzad thugs rje'i bdag /so so'i rigs kyi skur ston pa// khyung chen lngar ni rab tu grags// bgegs rigs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces pas bstod/ yig brgya brjod cing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur zhes bstim pa la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lhar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas rig pa'i lha mo rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba cung zad yo bar bzung ba rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha'i chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las/ yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi snying khar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba de'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing kha las 'od 'phro ba'i mtha' mar oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bskor ba sngags kyi phreng ba sbrul mgo langs pa lta bur byung ba/ a wa dhū ti'i nang nas mar song rdo rje'i bu ga nas thon yum gyi pad+mar brgyud de yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs shing*/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam/ skabs su hūm̐ dang sngags phreng las me 'bar bas lus kyi nang gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir thon/ gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad thul thul bsregs phyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi me'i rang bzhin can du 'bar bar bsam la/ rtsa ba'i snying po/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yi ge bcu pa 'bum tsho bcu song ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ/

duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya swā hā/ zhes 'bum tsho bcu'am rab 'bum tsho so drug song ba dang*/ gzhan yang*/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa/ bud+dha ga ru ḍa/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa/ rat+na ga ru ḍa/ karma ga ru ḍa/ zhes rigs lnga'i khyung so so'i sngags kha bsgyur sham bu can yang snga ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa bzla ba ni grangs bsnyen no// dus kyi bsnyen pa ni lo dang zla ba la sogs par ngag smra ba bcad de bzla'o// rtags kyi bsnyen pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu rnyed pa dang*/ me tog sngon po 'thu ba dang*/ sbrul brgyad lus la 'khril ba dang*/ rang lus me ru 'bar ba dang*/ gtum po'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang*/ gnod sbyin ded dpon byed pa dang*/ rgya mtsho rkang pas bskyod pa dang*/ ri rab klad la bskor ba dang*// rus sbal lag gis 'joms pa rnams// mngon sum nyams snang rmi lam la sogs par byung na rdo rje gtum po 'grub pa'i rtags so// rab gtum po dang zhal mjal ba dang*/ 'khor ba dang gzung 'dzin las blo logs ste bde stong dbyer med kyi don rtogs pa'ang 'byung ngo*// gang ltar bsnyen pa kho na'i tshe nyin bzhin thun bzhi'am gsum gyi tshul du nyams su len pa'i thun so so'i mtha' ma srod thun rjes su gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bcud rnams/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha /dbus su na las mi'i sha /de rnams kyi steng du shar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du ye shes lnga'i ngo bor shar du bh+rūṃ/ lhor aṃ/ nub tu dz+riṃ/ byang du khaṃ/ dbus su hūm̐/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa'i steng du/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa bsregs// dag pa bzhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa oṃ dang hūm̐ la phog /oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa thod par lhung ba'i rlangs pa dang*/ hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thod par lhung ste zhu nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsir 'dres pa kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun du skad cig gis rdo rje gtum po yab yum gsal btab pa'i ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'od kyi bu gu can gyis drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya swā hā/ ba liṃ ta i daṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi pū dza hoḥ rak+ta pi pa hoḥ sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid/ rdo rje gtum po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// yongs su bzhes nas bdag sogs rnams tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob cing gnas skabs su'ang nad gdon bgegs thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod gtor mgron rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ mdun bum sgrub pa dang 'brel na/ gtor ma bum sgrub mthar 'bul bas 'thus/ gang ltar thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo'i tshogs thams cad dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i dkyil 'khor chen por bsgyur ba 'od du zhu nas srung 'khor la thim/

de rang nyid rdo rje gtum po yab yum la/ yum yab la/ yab ye shes sems dpa' de ting nge 'dzin sems dpar de'ang zhabs kyu nas gyen rdzogs su yal te mthar mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur zhes mnyam par bzhag rjes/ ldang ba'i tshe/ slar yang chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du dpal gsang ba'i bdag po yab yum gyi sku snang stong zung 'jug chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gsang ba'i bdag sogs kyis bsngo smon bya/ de nas zas za ba'i tshe zas rnams 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ lte ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ pho ba me'i dkyil 'khor/ snying khar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje gtum po yab yum du bskyed/ lag pa hom gzar/ kha hom khung*/ zas sreg rdzas su bsams la snying kha'i lha tshogs mchod cing bde ba'i sgra dang bcas pas mnyes par bsam/ gos bgo ba'i tshe/ stod du bgo ba rnams dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang smad du dkris pa stag lpags kyi sham thabs su bsam/ nyal ba'i tshe stong nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe snang stong zung 'jug sprul pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o// mdor na spyod lam thams cad du snang ba sku/ grags pa gsung*/ dran rig thugs kyi rnal 'byor dang rgyun du ma bral bar bya'o// dam tshig tu rdo rje dril bu la mi 'gong zhing rtag tu bcang*/ me tog sngon po la mi 'gong*/ khyung gi dam tshig tu bya sha dang sgo nga mi za/ mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ ma 'grub bar du/ rta dang mi sha mi za/ klu gtor rgyun du gtong bar bya'o// de ltar rdo rje gtum po bsgrubs pas na phan yon dpag tu med pa yod de/ gsang ba bstan pa las/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku thob pa// tshe gcig nyid la 'gyur ba yin// rtag tu goms pa'i sbyor ba yis// sa sogs 'jig rten ma lus kun// skad cig nyid la dbang du 'gyur// gtsug na rin chen la sogs pa'i// gdug pa can rnams snying yang 'byin// dga' bo la sogs klu chen rnams// rtag tu de la 'dud par 'gyur// nad kyi rigs kun ma lus 'joms// gnod sbyin ma lus bka' nyan cing*// lha srin ma lus bran du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la/

mdun dkyil sgrub pa dang*/ bum sgrub gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa yan grub pa dang*/ mdun gyi rdul tshon nam ras bris/ tshom bu/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gtor ma bcas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar sogs/ de gnyis kha sbyar gyi bar du rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po sogs/ de nyid 'od du zhu ba las dpal rdo rje gtum po nas dbu brgyan par gyur bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ hūm̐/ kun tu bzang pos rgyal ba mchod pa'i tshe// ji ltar sprul rnams sku gsung thugs dang ni// ye shes rdo rje'i gsang ba las 'thon pa'i// 'dod dgu'i sprin gyis bcom ldan 'khor bcas mchod// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos sgron// dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga// bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga re re yang*// kun nas dgyes dgu kun tu sprul pas mchod// bzhin mdzes me tog dri zhim bdug pa'i spos// chags pa'i sgron ma drod kyis rdul ba'i chab// ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi ngoms med bde ba'i ro// 'dod pa'i snying por rjes su chags pas mchod// ma rig gis rmongs 'khor bar rengs pa'i 'gro// sdig pas smyos par gyur pa'i ma rungs pa// snying rje'i khros pas chos dbyings bsgral ba'i baṃ// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// zhes mchod/ hūm̐/ dus gsum bde gshegs sogs kyis gong gi bdag bskyed ltar bstod/ mdun bskyed lha'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i sogs/ dmigs la rtsa sngags dang khyung sham can sngags so sor ci nus bzlas/ gnyis pa ni/ bum pa las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang*/

bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla nyi'i gdan gyi steng du/ dpal rdo rje gtum po sogs gong ltar/ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa dang*/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bum bskyed la dbang bskur du gsol sogs dbu brgyan par gyur bar/ de nas/ hūm̐/ kun tu bzang pos sogs mdun bskyed ltar mchod cing bstod rjes/ gzungs thag blangs la/ bum lha'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba'i thugs pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing kha 'od 'phro ba'i mtha' mar oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bskor bar gsal ba dang*/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ bum lha'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas par phog pas sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud bskul/ hūm̐ sngags phreng bcas pa las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang*/ rdo rje gtum po'i skur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byin nus bsdus te thim pas sngags phreng dang*/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ rtsa bsnyen dang*/ khyung sham sngags bcas ci nus su bzlas/ dbang bskur byed na bum lha de gar bzhag la rjes chog skabs bsdu bas chog de nas las bum du gzungs thag spos la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las las kyi bum par pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las las kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang gu g.yas thod dbyug dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub can khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ ljang gu'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces bzlas mthar/ khro bo chen pos bgegs zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig lha 'od du zhu nas dag byed rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes mos te dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing 'thor ro// de nas gtor ma gong bsnyen dus su bshad pa bzhin/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rdo rje gtum po'i ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje 'od kyi bu gu can gyis drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya swā hā ba liṃ ta i daṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi pū dza hoḥ rak+ta pi pa hoḥ sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid/ rdo rje gtum po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// yongs su bzhes nas bdag sogs rnams tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob cing gnas skabs su'ang nad gdon bgegs thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phrin las gsol/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba'am bdag don byin rlabs kyi ched du bdag 'jug len na/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs kar bstim/ de'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i las kyi khro bos slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams mdzad par mos pas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang rnams mtshams sbyor dor ba sogs rgyas bsdus skabs phyed par byas te rdzogs par blangs la/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshe/ bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin// bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// ces brjod/ bsdu na ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang len te/ gnyis 'dzin rtog pa'i chos las grol// rang dang dbyer med lhan cig skyes// 'pho med bde chen ye shes kyi// rdo rje'i gsang gsum 'du 'bral med// byin rlabs rtsal chen rab rdzogs pas// 'brel tshad smin grol dbang thob shog/

ces lha dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i lta ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa gzhan don slob ma rjes 'dzin la/ slob ma rnams phyi rol sgo drung du las bum gyis khrus byas te gral du bkod/ bgegs gtor chab kyis bran/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs shud+dho3haṃ/ gtor ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid phyag na rdo rje'i rjes gnang gi rim pa bgyid pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad la sbyin no// 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig/

ces yungs kar gyis brab la 'dre 'jigs bdug rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol la/ sum+bha ni 'i sngags brjod pas bskrad/ rdo rje 'phyar la/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang mda'i dra ba/ phyi rol me kha dog lnga rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod pas srung 'khor bsgom/ maṇ+ḍal me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa'i ched du srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gtum po'i go 'phang bla na med pa 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan nas nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab ste gsan par 'tshal/ de'ang spyir rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid mi bskyod pa sogs zhi ba dang*/ badz+ra he ru ka sogs khro bo'i sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshom bu mtha' yas par spro zhing*/ gang 'dul der ston gyi sprin rgya mtshos chos dbyings khams kun rgyas par gtams pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa las/ phyogs re'i snang tshul tsam du'ang dpal phyag na rdo rje 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus shing*/ gdug pa'i log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms par mdzad pa dang*/ rgyal ba rnams kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i bdag por smon lam btab cing dbang bskur bas/ sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad srung ba dang*/ chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa sdud cing 'dzin pa por gyur pas gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi ka nas bstan pa'i rgyud dang*/ de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrub thabs bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs pa las/

bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs su phyag na rdo rje che ba dgu ru grags pa shin tu dar zhing byin rlabs bka' bab mchog dang ldan par gyur pa'i nang tshan/ gtum po khyung gi che ba zhes sam/ ras chung zhabs kyi man ngag sham bu can bco brgyad las phyag rdor khyung sham can/ dpal 'brug pa'i sgrub thabs skor lnga las gtum po nus mthu'i skor zhes grags pa ste/ de'ang dpal gsang ba mngon par bstan pa zhes pa'i rgyud chen po'i dgongs pa'i mthil/ rgya gzhung slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes gsal bar mdzad pa yin la/ dang po rgyud chen po 'di 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir spyod yul du byas chog pa ni/ slob dpon chen po dus zhabs pa che ba'am/ tsi lu pa ste/ khong phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i dge slong zhig gis khrid de byang phyogs lcang lo can du phyin/ nyi ma brtsegs pa'i khang pa na phyag na rdo rje dang mjal te dbang bskur/ rgyud 'di sogs phyag rdor gyi rgyud mang po gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs pas grub pa mchog brnyes nas/ 'phags pa'i yul du slar phebs nas skal ldan gyi slob ma mang po rjes su bzung ba las/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rje'am/ bla ma nags khrod par grags pa la phyag na rdo rje'i man ngag rnams gnang zhing des kyang bsgrubs pas grub/ dbang zhu dus dbang rtags su shing shir sha ka'i rdo rje zhig gnang ba des mtha'i dmag dpung bzlog pa sogs las kun mdzad pas las kyi rdo rje zhes par mtshan chags/ rgyud gsang ba bstan pa'i dgongs don bsdebs nas phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/ rigs kyi khro bo pho nya 'khor sgrub pa la sogs pa man ngag yi ger bkod de/ bram ze'i rnal 'byor pa thang shing gi steng du lo gsum sgom pa phyag na rdo rje'i grub pa thob pa zhig la gnang*/ des rigs ngan gyi rnal 'byor pa shing pa la sha'i lo mas 'dom dkris byas pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen po'i grub pa brnyes pa gcig la gnang*/

des yul dbus bhe ra ba'i rje btsun kar+ṇa ri pa bya bar gnang*/ des rang gi sring mo'i bu wa la tsan+d+ra la dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad man ngag tshang bar gnang ba/ glan lo tsā ba dar ma tshul khrims kyis zhus te gzhung man ngag phal cher bsgyur/ de las rje btsun mi la sku gzhon dus gsan par zhang tshul gzhon gyis zhus te rje btsun gyi man ngag zhal shes dag kyang dper bkod pa dang*/ yang rje ras chung pa sku na phra mo'i dus byis pa zla bo kha shas mnyam klu drag po gnas sar khyi gu'i ros dmar thab btang bas/ bsnyung mdze drag pos zin pa cis kyang drag tu ma btub pa/ rgya gar gyi a tsa ra mi gsum byung ba dang phrad pas bskul te/ 'phags yul du bla ma wa la tsan+d+ra mjal du phebs/ gser 'ga' yod pa phul bas rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba btab pas/ 'di'i gdams skor rnams gnang ba gsan te bsgrubs pas grub pa brnyes shing bsnyung mdze gzhi med du sangs/ bod du phebs nas bskyed rim gyi man ngag rgyas pa skor rje btsun mi la las gsan te gdams pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa 'di la/ sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor du byas pa/ phyi sgrub lha lnga/ nang sgrub lha bcu gsum/ gsang sgrub lha nyer gcig pa sogs dang*/ dkyil 'khor du ma byas pa/ dpa' gcig khyung lnga pa dang*/ me 'bar ma'i skor sogs bzhugs pa las/ 'dir dpa' bo gcig pa gtum po khyung lnga'i rgyan lha dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rjes gnang 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ras chung pa nas rgyal ba lo dang sum pa de gnyis kyis grub thob gling*/ des chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras/ dbon ras dar ma seṅge/ gzhon nu seṅge/ nyi ma seṅge/ rdor gling pa/ spos skya pa/ drin chen bcu gsum pa/ kun dga' seṅge/ bsam rgyal kha che/ blo gros seṅge/ ye shes rin chen/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shes rab bzang po/ rgyal dbang rje/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ gcung ngag gi dbang po/

mthu chen chos kyi mgon po/ gnyis ka las/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po/ lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po/ dpag bsam dbang po/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' lhun grub/ chos kyi dbang phyug mdo khams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bla ma chos rgyal rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo/ kun gzigs chos snang*/ ye shes grub pa/ 'jigs med mi 'gyur dbang rgyal/ shes bya kun mkhyen nas 'dren mchog shes rab dpal bzang dang*/ mdo khams drug pa bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gnyis kas rdo rje 'dzin pa rin po che mthu chen chos kyi rgya mtsho ste/ dam pa de nyid kyi bka' drin las bdag la legs par thob pa lags/ de lta bu'i bka' srol khyad par ba las byung ba'i rjes su gnang ba bgyid pa la thog mar bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gtum po yab yum dbyer ma mchis pa'i spyan sngar rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes mtshams sbyar la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i spyan sngar thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa che// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems mchog bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum/ de nas yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dang por gsum la skyabs su btang*// de nas bla med byang chub sems// ma skyed pa rnams bskyed par bya// bskyed pa dag kyang dran par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ 'o skol rnams 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i dpung gnyen ni dkon mchog gsum kho nar nges la/ de yang rang nyid gcig pu'i ched du ma yin par sems can thams cad pha ma drin can du shes pa'i nges pas drangs nas theg pa chen po'i skyabs 'gro dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sems bskyed la 'bad dgos pas/

de'i slad du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus 'di na bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po rgyan lha dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs par gsal btab pa'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang mtha' skor du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems rgyud sde bzhi nas gsungs pa'i yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa thams cad sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar lam log pa las khyad par du gyur pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ lam dman pa las khyad par du gyur pa sems bskyed kyi sdom pa bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces lan gsum gyis skyabs sems sdom pa blangs/ de nas dbang gi gzhi ye shes pa dbab cing*/ sku'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ las sgros bum chu 'thor zhing*/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ khyed rang rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar re re bzhin sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar pad+ma zla nyi brtsegs pa'i gdan la sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po dang a dmar po gnyis su gyur pa 'od du zhu ba las dpal rdo rje gtum po sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyangs bas dbang phyug chen po kha dog sngon po mnan pa/ g.yas bskums pas u ma de wi kha dog dmar po mnan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum me stag gi phung po ltar dmar ba/ dbu skra ag tshoms smin ma khams ser gyen du 'bar ba/

sbrul dkar pos thod du bcings pa/ ser pos rna cha dang mgul brgyan pa/ ljang gus lag gdub/ dmar pos mgul rgyan dang ska rags/ nag pos do shal dang rkang gdub byas pa/ chos gos sngon pos stod dkris shing rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bde ma sku mdog dmar ljang gcer bu skra grol zhing thur du 'phyang ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i gri gug sdigs par mdzad pa/ g.yon pa bdud la sogs pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas dbang phyug gi steng du brkyangs shing*/ g.yon yab dang gnyis med du 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros sa steng sa bla sa 'og gi sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje gtum po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i rigs thams cad bsdus nas gnas gsum gyi phyag mtshan yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pa las/ spyi bor sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo// mgrin par gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ snying khar thugs rdo rje sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o// mig tu bruṃ las spyan ras gzigs/ rna bar hūm̐ las nam mkha'i snying po/ snar khaṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel/ lcer aṃ las 'jam dbyangs/ dpral bar hūm̐ las 'od dpag med/ snying khar haṃ las kun tu bzang po/ yab kyi thugs kar badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūm̐ rdo rje'i khyung sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sbrul sngo khra bzung nas za ba/

mchu gshog thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin can/ bud+dha ga ru ḍa oṃ/ spyi bor 'khor lo'i khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon sbrul dkar khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can/ pad+ma ga ru ḍa hrīḥ mgrin par pad+ma'i khyung dmar po g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon sbrul dmar khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad pad+ma'i rang bzhin can/ rat+na ga ru ḍa trām̐/ lte bar rin po che'i khyung ser po g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon sbrul ser khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad rin po che'i rang bzhin can/ karma ga ru ḍa ā/ gsang gnas su ral gri'i khyung ljang khu g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon sbrul ljang khra bzung nas za ba/ mchu gshog thams cad ral gri'i rang bzhin can/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje mthing nag 'bar ba'i lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas par gsal thob mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyis mdun gyi dbang rdzas gtor mar bcas pa'ang yi dam phyag na rdo rje yab yum rgyan lha khyung lngar bcas pa mngon sum gsal rdzogs su khra lam mer bzhugs pa'i mos 'dun dang*/ slob dpon yang dpal gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su gsal bzhin par mos gus kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i thugs srog la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i sku'i rnam par che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam/ steng nas char 'bab pa lta bu/ 'og nas sa rlangs 'thon pa lta bu/ bar nas bu yug 'tshub pa lta bu/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar byon nas khyed rang rnams gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i sku la mtsho la char 'bab pa lta bu thim pas khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum dang phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur cing ye shes pa phebs byung snyam pa gyis la sems ma bcos par lhod la zhog cig/

spos rol bya zhing gtor ma spyi bor bzhag oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sogs snying po'i mthar ā be sha ya a a zhes btags pa brjod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ gtor ma'i lhar phog de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i zhing nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes kyi khyung chen rigs lnga'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar byon pa dang*/ mdun bskyed lha'i gnas lnga'i khyung so so las rang 'dra'i sku sprul pa rnams byon te khyed rnams lhar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i khyung so sor rim pa bzhin thim pa'i mos pa gyis byas la/ 'khor lo'i khyung dkar po'i tsakli spyi bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ/ rtag pa'i rigs chen 'khor lo'i khyung*// dkar po 'khor lo sbrul dkar 'dzin// kha rlangs dug can rje rigs klu// ma lus 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ bud+dha ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces brjod cing dbang bskur/ pad+ma'i khyung dmar tsakli mgrin par bzhag ste/

hrīḥ rta mchog rigs chen pad+ma'i khyung*// dmar po chu skyes sbrul dmar 'dzin// bsam pa'i dug can bram ze'i klu// ma lus 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ pad+ma ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ sogs/ rdo rje'i khyung mthing tsakli snying gar bzhag ste/ hūm̐/ mi bskyod rigs chen rdo rje'i khyung*// mthing ka rdo rje sbrul sngon 'dzin// rang bzhin dug can gdol pa'i klu// ma lus 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ sogs/ rin chen khyung ser po'i tsakli lte bar bzhag ste/ trām̐ḥ nyi ma'i rigs chen rin chen khyung*// ser po nor bu sbrul ser 'dzin// mthong ba'i dug can rgyal rigs klu// ma lus 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ rat+na ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ sogs/ ral gri'i khyung ljang gu'i tsakli gsang bar bzhag ste/ āḥ don yod rigs chen las kyi khyung*// ljang khu ral gri sbrul ljang 'dzin// reg pa'i dug can dmangs rigs klu// ma lus 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ karma ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ sogs/ de ltar ye shes khyung chen rigs lnga'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pas/ ma rig dug lnga'i 'khrul snang las shar ba'i steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan/ bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pa dang*/ nad gdon bar chad rkyen ngan mi mthun phyogs tshar bcad de/ dug lnga rnam dag ye shes rnam pa lnga'i rtsal kha phyogs med du rgyas par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod cig de nas slar yang brtan byed chu'i dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs srog hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/

mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas mngon par dbang bskur bar mos mdzod byas/ rnam bum btegs la/ hūm̐/ sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i// ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med// lha yi bdud rtsi rnam dag 'dis// mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra ā dar+she dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod bzhin pas bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud de khrus bya/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus gang dri ma dag rig pa'i ye shes bskyed chu rgyun gyen du rengs pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ gzhan yang dbang lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du thim par gyur pa la mchod pa 'bul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ las rdor gyis chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga phreng tshar du bsgrigs pa slob ma rnams kyi mdun ngos nas 'degs bzhin pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang rol mor bcas pas mchod/ de rnams kyis sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob pas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang bag chags thams cad dag lus la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa grib dang mi gtsang ba dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sogs mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad zhi/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas phyag na rdo rje'i sku bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku 'grub par 'gyur ba'i skal ldan du byas pa yin no// de nas gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gnyis ka phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa re mched de zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnams phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs te thugs ka'i sa bon gyis mthar 'khod ba'i mos par bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces sngags phreng sbrel nas bsgrangs la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa zhes snying po lan gsum dang*/ spro na khyung lnga'i sham bu can gyi sngags bzlas lung bya/ de ltar lan gsum gyi dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas bstims/ gsum pas nus pa rgyud la brtan par byas/ khyed rnams kyis dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du phyag na rdo rje 'di nyid yi dam du brtan par bzung snyam pas/ me tog gi phreng ba re phul ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas dngos su 'bru 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng ba'i rnam par byin brlabs te spyi bor bcing par mos shig bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// nus pa brtan par mdzad du gsol// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i gsung gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i byin nus ma lus khyod kyi ngag la thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig/ ces brjod de sngags pa'i me tog spyi bor bzhag pa'am 'thor/ des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba mtha' rten bcas thob pas ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag ngag la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas phyag na rdo rje'i sngags bzla ba dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum thogs pa med pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub par 'gyur ba'i skal ldan du byas pa yin no// de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/

gsal la mi rtog rig pa'i sku// mi gnas mi 'bral 'dus ma byas// ye shes zhes ni de la bya// bcom ldan phyag rdor mtshan nyid yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don te/ de'ang lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ sems dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad nas gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du 'jog mdzod/ slar yang brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas thugs kyi byin rlabs phyag mtshan rdo rje'i tshogs che chung grangs med pa 'phros khyed rnams kyi snying gar thim pas phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob cing brtan par byas pa'i mos par mdzod/ phyag mtshan rdo rje snying gar reg la/ snying po'i mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pas/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma rig pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag yid la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bgegs dang sdig sgrib bar chad 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa grib dang mi gtsang ba/ ma rig pa/ mi shes pa/ gti mug pa sogs mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad zhi/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yid kyi sgo nas phyag na rdo rje'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu mkhyen brtse nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa chos kyi sku 'grub par 'gyur ba'i skal ldan du byas pa yin no// mtha' rten gtor ma'i bka' bsgo dang byin rlabs bya bar spro na/ khyed rang rnams dpal gsang ba'i bdag por gsal btab bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ gtor ma 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa la/ slob dpon gyis gzungs sngags brjod cing rtsa brgyud bla ma'i mtshan nas smos te gsol ba btab pa ltar byin rlabs dang dngos grub ma lus pa thams cad gnang zhing thob byung snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu gtad de smon lam thob mdzod/

bla mas gtor ma bteg la/ yi dam gyi rtsa sngags dang*/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po tsi lu pa/ las kyi rdo rje/ thang lo pa/ shing lo pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ wa la tsan+d+ra/ glan lo dar ma tshul khrims/ rje btsun ras chen bzhad pa rdo rje/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rgyal ba lo dang sum pa/ gling ras pad+ma rdo rje/ mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras pa nas/ bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin sum ldan gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin dngos mthu stobs chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bar du byon pa'i drin can rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang ḍā ki /rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung mar bcas pa dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gtum po ye shes khyung gi lha tshogs dang bcas pas rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams kyi nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog dang bcas pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i gegs dang bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor bde skyid snyan grags mnga' thang nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan gyi rtsal kha 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ snod bcud lha 'dre mi gsum srid pa dang zhi ba'i dpal yon dngos grub ma lus pa dbang du 'du bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdud dgra log par 'dren pa'i mi dang mi min gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba rnams skad cig nyid du drag po mngon spyod kyi stobs kyis tshar gcod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i gsang gsum ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyis gnas skabs mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rgyal zhing*/ mthar thug zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang tshe gcig lus gcig la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// yi dam gsang ba'i bdag po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// klu rigs kun 'joms khyung chen lnga'i// dngos grub bla med 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur yongs rdzogs pas// mi mthun bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal zhing*// gsang bdag go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ba ling+ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ zhes brjod bzhin gtor ma spyi bor 'jog slar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes srung bas rgyas gdab/ gtor ma gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba mar me gcig las gnyis kyi mched tshul du khyed rnams kyi spyi bor byon 'od du zhu nas gnyis su med par thim pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dbyer ma mchis par 'dres par bsgom mdzod/ ces gtor zan dngos grub tu cung zad re sbyin no// de ltar mtha' rten gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bgyid min gang ltar yang mjug tu/ de rnams kyi sgo nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po khyung lnga'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas/ spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig la tshul bzhin du gnas shing*/ lha mchog 'di nyid yi dam du 'dzin snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs lan gsum gyis dam tshig khas blangs/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal dang*/ dge bsngo spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams gyes/ gsum pa rjes de dag gi mjug bsdu ba ni/ mchod pa gsar du bsham pa'am kha gsos la/ gong ltar byin brlabs/ hūm̐/ kun tu bzang pos sogs mchod cing*/ hūm̐/ dus gsum bde gshegs= kyis bstod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog/

ces smon lam gdab/ dril bu gsil zhing yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang*/ lhag pa dang ni sogs brjod de bzod par gsol/ mdun bum du bskyed pa'i ye shes pa tsakli sogs sku gsung thugs rten la/ 'dir ni gzugs dang nas mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes 'bru 'thor la brten bzhugs bya/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang dge bsngo bcas gong bsnyen dus bshad pa ltar bya/ dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod spyi dang*/ khyad par/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku// gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen mo// rdo rje bde ma bde ster ma// rtog pa thams cad gcod mdzad pa'i// yum mchog de yi= khams gsum sems can thams cad la// mi ma yin gyi 'tshe byed pa// 'joms phyir khyung chen sku sprul nas// 'gro don mdzad pa'i= rnam rtog 'joms mdzad thugs rje'i bdag /so so'i rigs kyi skur ston pa// khyung chen lnga ni rab tu grags// bgegs rigs 'joms pa'i bkra shis shog/ ces sogs bkra shis kyi tshig phreng ci yang brjod pas mtha' brgyan no// de nas rdul tshon yod na a kā ro 'i sngags brjod cing mtha' nas dbus su bsdus la rin po che'i bum par blugs nas chur gshegs/ gzhan tshom bu'am gtor mchod sogs bsdu zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i lta bas rgyas gdab/ mchod pa'i ras ma la longs mi spyod cing gtsang sar 'dor bar bya'o/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul// dran pas dmigs med gzhom la mthu stobs bdag /dper 'os gzhan gyis srid zhir phongs de phyir// nus mthu'i skor zhes grags pa'i ri mo gsal// gong ma'i gsung la rang bzos ma sbags par// lugs 'di 'phel ba'i blo gros dkar po'i mthu// brtas pas legs bsgrubs dge des 'gro ba kun// rdo rje'i khro rgyal gsang gsum 'grub gyur cig/

ces gtum po khyung lnga dpa' bo gcig tu bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i thabs/ gzhan don rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa bcas bklag chog bltas gsal 'di'ang*/ sngon dus su bka' srol 'di dar rgyas che la/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang mang zhig lam 'di las grub pa'i rgyal thabs la gshegs pas 'phags bod kyi ljongs mdzes par gyur mod/ da dus rjes gnang gi rgyun ma nub tsam kho na las/ bsnyen sgrub nyams len gyi phyag srol nyams pa ltar gyur pa slar gso'i cha rkyen du sman zhing*/ rang mnyam skal dman blo rtul rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i slad du dmigs te/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rdo rje pha lam kar lugs kyi gcig shes kun grol sogs khungs thub yig chas zur cung zad brgyan te/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan zhabs 'dzin pa'i zob brdzu mkhan blun rmongs 'du gsum pa khams sprul don brgyud nyi mar 'bod pas/ kha bzhi lho'i sman ljongs dam pa chos kyi zhing mchog bye brag krong sar rta phag ri khrod zung 'jug grub pa'i dga' tshal du sbyar ba 'gro kun gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /
